LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Enlist_Letter_Label: Your colony now stands with the Fighters Guild. Open the guild ledger at any settlement hosting them to draw pay, take work and see your standing.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Enlist_Button_Desc: Sign on with the Fighters Guild. Honest contracts, honest pay, and a chapter house in every city that will have one.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Enlist_Requrements_No: The Fighters Guild does not trust you yet. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Enlisted_To_Hostile_F: You cannot join the Fighters Guild while your colony is at odds with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Missions_Desc: See what work the guild has posted.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Menu_Missions_Desc: Open contracts posted by the Fighters Guild. Accepting one costs nothing; payment comes when it is done.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Salary_Desc: Collect your share from the guild's steward.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Provisions_Desc: Take what the guild sets aside for its members on the road.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in the guild's keeping and collect them from any hall.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave the Fighters Guild? Your standing will suffer for it.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Resign_Letter_Label: Your colony has left the Fighters Guild. Its doors are closed to you for now.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Resign_Button_Desc: Give up your membership and every rank that goes with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Kick_Out_Label_Title: Relations have fallen too far. The Fighters Guild has struck your colony from its books.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Work_0_Desc: Ride as a hired guard on local trade roads. Tiring work, but steady coin.
LanguageData.ESCP_FightersGuild_Work_1_Desc: Spend the days on the practice yard under a veteran's eye.
